featured_reviews.review_text:
‼️”Savouring Sweet Moments: A Renovated Delight at Rajasthan Sweets, Jogeshwari”‼️

⭐⭐⭐⭐

“Rajasthan Sweets” on S.V. Road in Jogeshwari has been a long-time favorite for its delectable sweets, and I must say, they never disappoint in taste. However, the recent renovation has elevated the experience with a charming ambience that adds to the joy of indulging in their delightful treats.

While the service has improved, there’s still room for enhancement to match the quality of their sweets. Nonetheless, their RasMalai and Kala Jamun remain unparalleled, consistently delivering bursts of flavor and satisfaction with every bite.

Overall, “Rajasthan Sweets” continues to be a go-to destination for sweet cravings, earning a solid 4-star rating for their delicious offerings and inviting atmosphere. 🍬✨ #RajasthanSweets #SweetIndulgence

With time we have established ourselves into a diverse range of products under the brand name Ghaswala Dairy Fresh. We also expertise into manufacturing and serving our customers a finest choice of Indian Sweets, Bengali Sweets, Cakes, Snacks, Namkeen and Kulfi under one roof.

featured_reviews.name: Imtiaz Danawala
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am writing this to express my serious concern regarding the hygiene standards at Ghaswala Dairy Fresh. During my visit today, I noticed a significant amount of black dust/particles in the milk.

​When I brought this to the attention of the staff member at the milk counter, they dismissively remarked that 'some debris is expected in milk' and attempted to merely push the dust aside using the measuring unit rather than filtering the milk properly. Even after returning home, the particles remained, making the milk unsuitable for consumption.

​A dairy business has a responsibility to provide clean, filtered products. Dismissing hygiene concerns is unprofessional and a health risk. I hope management takes this feedback seriously and implements better filtering and safety protocols immediately
